dimensions.label: Motion adherence
evidence: can I ask how many caregivers you've got out in the field right now?
dimensions.tip: Complete fuller discovery on goals, timeline, and decision process before pivoting into the product pitch.

dimensions.label: Discovery quality
evidence: what's driving you to look at something like this right now?
dimensions.tip: Ask discovery questions upfront and probe deeper on decision criteria, timeline, and budget before launching into the product explanation.

dimensions.label: Talk / listen balance
dimensions.tip: Aim for more listening — open with questions and let the buyer talk.

dimensions.label: Buying-signal detection & handling
evidence: we've had some caregiver turnover so oversight has been thinner than usual.
dimensions.tip: Explicitly qualify the turnover and family-complaint signals by asking about urgency, budget, and who else is involved in the decision.

dimensions.label: Objection handling
evidence: Maybe something on how it handles families who don't speak English as a first language
dimensions.tip: Address the language-support question directly on the call rather than deferring entirely to a follow-up packet.

dimensions.label: Proof-point fidelity
evidence: we've had agencies catch a UTI starting to develop just from the voice sentiment analysis before it turned into a hospital visit
dimensions.tip: Cite the published 23% readmission drop figure instead of an unverified anecdote to keep claims consistent with Sensi's proof points.

dimensions.label: Next-step specificity
evidence: I'll send that over in the next day or two.
dimensions.tip: Lock in a specific dated call or meeting to review the proposal rather than a vague 'I'll send it over.'
